question: The NITI Aayog was formed by replacing the Planning Commission of India on _______ 2015.
solution:
The correct answer is **__1st January.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **NITI Aayog was formed via a resolution of the Union Cabinet on January 1, 2015.**
 
• National Institution for Transforming India, also called NITI Aayog, **replaced the Planning commission in the year 2015.**
 
• NITI Aayog is the premier policy** 'Think Tank of the Government of India, providing both directional and policy inputs**.
 
• NITI Aayog also provides relevant technical advice to the Centre and States.
 
• **The Prime Minister as its Chairman **comprises Chief Ministers of all States and Lt. Governors of Union Territories (UTS).
 
• **Composition of NITI Aayog**
 
 
• **Chairperson: Prime Minister.**
 
• **Vice Chairperson: Suman Berry**
 
• **Governing Council: CM's (States) and Lieutenant Governors (Union Territories).**
 
• **Regional Councils: Formed on a need-basis, incorporates CMS and Lieutenant Governors of the region.**
 
• **Part-time Members: Maximum 2, Rotational, from relevant institutions.**
 
• **CEO: ****Parameswaran Iyer**
